title: Surrogate Graph Partitioning for Spatial Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2510.07832v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spatial prediction refers to the estimation of unobserved values from spatially distributed observations. Although recent advances have improved the capacity to model diverse observation types, adoption in practice remains limited in industries that demand interpretability. To mitigate this gap, surrogate models that explain black-box predictors provide a promising path toward interpretable decision making. In this study, we propose a graph partitioning problem to construct spatial segments that minimize the sum of within-segment variances of individual predictions. The assignment of data points to segments can be formulated as a mixed-integer quadratic programming problem. While this formulation potentially enables the identification of exact segments, its computational complexity becomes prohibitive as the number of data points increases. translated_title: 面向空间预测的代理图划分
translated_abstract: 空间预测是指从空间分布的观测值中估计未观测到的值。尽管近期的进展提升了对多种观测类型建模的能力，但在需要可解释性的行业中，实际应用仍然有限。为弥合这一差距，能够解释黑盒预测器的代理模型为实现可解释决策提供了一条有前景的路径。在本研究中，我们提出一个图划分问题，用于构建空间分段，使各分段内个体预测值的方差之和最小。将数据点分配到分段的问题可以被表述为一个混合整数二次规划问题。虽然这种表述有可能识别出精确的分段，但随着数据点数量的增加，其计算复杂度会变得难以承受。受此挑战的启发，我们开发了一种利用该结构的近似求解方案……
tldr: 本文提出将代理图划分问题建模为混合整数二次规划，用于构建使分段内预测方差之和最小的空间分段，并针对其计算复杂度过高的问题开发了高效的近似求解方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates surrogate graph partitioning as a mixed-integer quadratic programming problem to construct spatial segments that minimize the sum of within-segment variances of predictions, and develops an efficient approximation scheme to overcome its prohibitive computational complexity.
